title: Canonical NDC v2 Profile 1 detached signature sidecar — version 1
description: Exactly five fields. The sidecar is outside the canonical manifest bytes; the manifest digest appears here and nowhere in the manifest. No domain field, no sixth member, no embedded key material and no private key.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the complete RFC 8785 canonical manifest byte sequence. No property is removed, blanked or withheld before canonicalization.

signature_b64.description: Standard padded base64 of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the domain prefix concatenated with the 32-byte digest.

SignatureSidecar.description: Exactly five members. key_id must bind to the manifest publisher_identity and signing_key_id through the out-of-band trusted registry; this binding is a semantic constraint.
